name: Strike Lab Fighting Arena
request: Create a small, playable Strike Lab fighting-game training arena for one player on desktop and touch. Include a humanoid training dummy, a three-hit light-attack combo with visible windup, contact and recovery animations, synchronized hit sound effects, a visible accepted-hit counter and dummy health. The server must validate attack timing and range. Each accepted strike damages and counts once at contact; swinging out of range, holding the button or spamming during recovery must not create extra hits. Show distinct hit and miss feedback. After defeat, reset the dummy and let the player practice again; provide a clear reset control and an uncluttered arena. Search Marketplace first for complete reusable combat/training components, compatible dummy rigs, existing animations and sound rather than rebuilding everything. Inspect compatibility, behavior and included media, preserve useful working pieces and author only missing integration. Source missing audio from Marketplace and verify actual playing animations and audible sounds. Record an importer capability gap honestly rather than treating it as a bad asset. Choose reasonable styling and damage values yourself. No PvP, matchmaking, saving, monetization or large world. Success needs native evidence for the full combo, exact counting, misses, recovery spam, defeat/reset and desktop/touch controls. A damage script with a static dummy does not meet the animation requirement.

When full combat packages are inspected, preserve working rigs, hit animations, and impact sound effects while authoring authoritative server validation, exact 3-hit combo state machines, anti-spam guards, and responsive desktop/touch HUD controls.
spec.title: Strike Lab Fighting Arena
spec.summary: A dedicated fighting-game combat training arena designed for single-player practice on desktop and touch devices. Players spawn inside a focused dojo-style strike lab facing an interactive training dummy. The combat system features a tight 3-hit light-attack sequence (Jab, Cross, Roundhouse/Finisher) with distinct windup, active contact window, and recovery frames. The server authoritatively validates attack timing, player range to dummy, and anti-spam recovery locks, ensuring each valid contact registers exactly one hit, plays synchronized impact audio/VFX, and updates dummy health and the accepted-hit combo counter. Misses, out-of-range swings, and recovery spam produce clear miss feedback without incrementing hits. When the dummy reaches zero health, it enters a defeat state and can be reset instantly via on-screen UI or an arena prompt. Desktop controls support mouse click / keyboard (F / M1) while touch devices provide ergonomic on-screen action buttons.
spec.visualDirection: The arena is styled as a sleek, high-visibility Strike Lab training dojo. A central elevated sparring mat (8-sided circular ring with high-contrast boundary lines and stance markers) centers the action. Atmospheric perimeter lighting, grid floor detailing, and minimalist perimeter barriers keep the focus sharp and uncluttered. Combat feedback includes distinct floating strike impacts (bright flash particles + hit sparks for hits, subtle air-swish trail and soft whoosh for misses). Floating damage/counter billboard numbers pop dynamically near the dummy's head, accompanied by a clean combat HUD showing dummy health, active combo counter, hit confirmation ticker, and an accessible reset button.

requirements.description: Implement a 3-hit light-attack combo chain (Strike 1: Jab, Strike 2: Cross, Strike 3: Roundhouse Finisher) with defined windup, active contact, and recovery phases. The server must validate timing, combo reset windows, and player proximity before registering any hit.
